chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Shu'ayb, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Oil smoothens the skin, increases strength in the brain, eases the flow of water (urine), removes scaling (dryness), and improves the complexion.'

key_terms.الدُّهْنُ: Oil (used for massage or skin care)
key_terms.الْقَشَفِ: Scaling or dryness of the skin
key_terms.مَجَارِيَ الْمَاءِ: The flow of water (referring to urine)

ai.seo_question: What are the physical and health benefits of using oil for massage according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi, attributes to Imam Ali (AS) a holistic view of oiling that bridges physical hygiene and spiritual well-being, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the body as an amanah (trust). The mention of 'facilitating the flow of water' (urination) and 'brain strength' underscores the Prophetic tradition's attention to both physiological health and cognitive vitality, while 'removing scaling' (qashaf) points to the importance of cleanliness (taharah) in worship.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Shuayb, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The oiling (massaging) smoothens the person (skin), and increases in the brain power, and eases the flow of the water (urination), and it removes the scaling (dryness of the skin) and improves the complexion’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from Shu’ayb from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘
Applying oil softens the skin, increases the abilities of the brain, opens the channels of water, removes the scaling and improves color (of the skin).”’
